title: Campaigns and events
subtitle: Publish slides on the home page and make the site follow the event's colours. The DevOps Akademy identity (logo, name, tagline) always stays visible.

status_hint.live: Visible on the site right now.
status_hint.scheduled: Will show from the start date.
status_hint.ended: The end date has passed: no longer visible.

list.empty_text: Create a campaign (Pink October, holidays, back to school…): it will appear as slides on the home page and the site will take its colours.
list.period_always: No dates: you switch it on and off by hand
list.toggle_on: On: visible according to the dates
list.delete_confirm: Delete the campaign “{{title}}” and all its slides? This cannot be undone.

campaign.title: Campaign name
campaign.theme_none: Do not change the site colours
campaign.apply_theme: Apply this theme to the whole site during the campaign
campaign.apply_theme_help: Unchecked: only the slides are shown, the site colours do not change.
campaign.active_help: This is the main switch: when off, nothing is visible, even within the planned period.
campaign.dates_help: Without dates, the campaign stays visible as long as it is on. With dates, it turns on and off by itself, and you can still switch it off by hand. Your device's time.
campaign.dates_order: The end date must be after the start date.
campaign.priority_help: If several campaigns are live at the same time, the theme of the one with the highest priority applies.
campaign.created_hint: Campaign created. Now add its slides below.

slides.empty: No slides. Add at least one slide so the campaign shows on the home page.
slides.save_first: Save the campaign first to add slides.
slides.label: Label (small text above the title)
slides.title: Title
slides.title_ph: I am a woman. I move forward.
slides.body_ph: One concept. One post. Every week.
slides.image_help: Upload the image from your computer or paste its address.
slides.linkedin_help: On LinkedIn: ••• on the post › Embed this post › copy the code. You can paste the whole code or just the address (https://www.linkedin.com/embed/…).
slides.cta_help: Full address (https://…) or a site page (/courses, /register…).
slides.need_content: Add at least a title, an image or a LinkedIn post.

themes.intro: A theme is a set of 4 colours applied to the whole public site. The admin panel always keeps the normal colours. Create a theme for each new event.
themes.locked: The Normal theme is the usual identity: it cannot be edited.
themes.name: Event / theme name
themes.generate: Generate the shades from the main colour
themes.check_white_on_primary: White text on the main colour
themes.check_white_on_dark: White text on the dark colour
themes.check_warning: Some contrasts are low: text may be hard to read. You can save, but adjust the colours if possible.
themes.in_use: This theme is used by campaigns: change their theme first.
